programme.title: Dingomaro
programme.desc: Iranian musician Hamid embarks on a journey through Hormozgan to unite black artists for a concert.

programme.title: Amazing Iran
programme.desc: For the Iranian Turkmen a wedding is one of most important social events in their culture and is still celebrated according to old nomadic tradition. The Turkmen Steppe, the country of a thousand mountains, is a tribute to the hidden treasure that is Iran. Home to a proud nation with a majestic history, we show the freedom of a nomadic life, encounter the wild nature of the people and discover old traditions like the Turkmen wedding. Breathtaking sceneries create a mysticism that transports viewers into the realm of divinity while exposing a world caught between tradition and modernity - nomadism and sedentarism. Weddings in Iran are primarily arrangements between families and the product of lengthy negotiations. Even though many customs are purely symbolic, they still reflect the great significance as a rite of transition for the newlyweds and their families. The life of the Turkmen housewife revolves around weddings – first her own, later those of her children. Raising healthy, capable daughters and sons searching for possible partners mediating contact negotiating each betrothal with the family of the intended shouldering the wedding arrangements and the observance of customs and traditions – the responsibility for all of that falls to the mother. Though the Turkmen daughters and sons of today do insist on having their say, love, affection, trust and the like are still not the decisive criteria in making a match. The main consideration is not the subjective happiness of the couple but the happiness, stability and honor of each of their families as a whole. So it is still not uncommon for the bride and groom to be virtual strangers on their wedding day. The nuptials as a ritual of transition mark a series of profound changes – especially in the life of the bride. Once married, she leaves her family and her home village to take her new place within the family of the groom.

programme.title: Australia's Amazing Homes

Discover some truly amazing conversions that manage to successfully combine modern design without elminating the original charm of the old buildings - and the results are spectacular.

programme.title: The Jade Princess
programme.desc: In the wake of an assassination attempt targeting the royal family, the ninja invite the royal princess, HARUMI, into their makeshift family. Lloyd glimpses someone escaping over the rooftops with a sack on their back. Fearing it is the kidnapped princess, Lloyd takes up the chase! He discovers to his surprise, however, that the masked intruder is none other than the princess herself, who is not quite as docile or meek as she pretends. She has a habit of sneaking out of her chambers at night to feed the homeless who surround the Imperial Palace. This revelation only endears her to Lloyd more and Harumi and Lloyd quickly strike up a friendship. Unfortunately, trouble catches up to the ninja when the Sons Of Garmadon target the second Oni mask and attack the palace. The scope of the attack proves more than the Ninja were prepared for as the Sons of Garmadon detonate a series of subterranean bombs, bringing down part of the palace. Lloyd and Harumi escape onto the flying ship, DESTINY'S BOUNTY. But the victory is a pyrrhic one. The second Oni Mask has been stolen and Harumi's parents and Master Hutchins are feared lost.

programme.title: The Pranks
programme.desc: The friends are using their talents to pull a prank on Olivia. But who gets the last laugh? Stephanie finds the perfect front page story for the school paper! It's almost too good to be true. Emma and Andrea go undercover to solve the mystery of the two Jacobs.

programme.title: Girls on Mission
programme.desc: Stephanie has to face her fears when the class gets an 'Animal Kingdom & 'school assignment.'Mia and Stephanie have to use a little horse power at the Sunshine Ranch. Olivia tapes a science show, with a little help from Mia's lemonade stand - and special effects! Emma and Stephanie accidentally rent a scary movie and suddenly there are beasts everywhere... Things are getting mixed up on Andrea's first day on the job at Heartlake City Juicebar. Andrea relaxes at the beach while Emma is hard at work at her lifeguard tower.

programme.title: The Hands Of Time
programme.desc: Master Wu mistakenly tries to single-handedly complete a battle he began decades ago against Acronix, one of the twin Hands of Time. But the arrival of the first Time Blade – a weapon with the power to speed up time – sends the Ninja to the Monastery just in time to rescue their master from certain doom.

programme.title: The Hatching
programme.desc: The Ninja learn more about the Krux and Acronix – the two fallen Elemental Masters known as the Hands of Time – and are sure that this threat has finally been eliminated. But with Wu out of action and suffering from the effects of the Time Punch, the Ninja discover a new enemy in their midst: The Vermillion Warriors. And the Ninjas have no idea who controls them...

programme.title: A Time Of Traitors
programme.desc: Kai's investigation of a Vermillion Warrior Helmet leads him to discover that Krux is alive and well in Ninjago, living under an assumed identity. Meanwhile, as the Vermillion Warriors go on a kidnapping spree, Lloyd struggles with his role as master-in-training and Nya does her best to reboot Zane, who was knocked off line in his first battle with the Vermillion.

programme.title: The Mask Of Deception
programme.desc: When an unknown criminal syndicate threatens the Royal Family, the Ninja are called back into action and must protect the royal princess and a fabled artifact that may hold supernatural powers. The ninja find themselves scattered to the four corners of the kingdom. Cole and Jay are searching in vain for some sign of Master Wu. Nya fights injustice in the north, while Kai and Zane attempt to fend off an angry lava beast in the west. This leaves Lloyd alone in Ninjago City. He rushes to the scene of a heist at Borg Tower and finds himself up against a team of highly trained operatives led by the mysterious masked MISTER-E. Lloyd fails to prevent the heist and an ancient artifact, the MASK OF DECEPTION, is stolen. Lloyd apprehends one of the criminals but the others escape. Dismayed by his failure, Lloyd calls the ninjas back to Ninjago. The friends are reunited and hope for a little rest and relaxation. These hopes are dashed with the arrival MASTER HUTCHINS, a servant of the Royal Family of Ninjago, who has been sent by the EMPEROR to request their help. A new criminal gang, SONS OF GARMADON (SOG), is attempting to acquire three ancient masks called the ONI MASKS, which are rumored to possess supernatural powers.

programme.title: The Gray Knight
programme.desc: Using his Stone to Life magic the Cloud of Monstrox turns Clay into a living, fighting, breathing stone fighting knight. But will Clay use his forces to fight for good or for evil? Does he have a choice? The Cloud of Monstrox and Jestro are able to unlock the forbidden Power Shocking Scare and unleash an attack on the village of Bravington. Knights in their new vehicles rush to the rescue and are able to defeat him with a new Combo Power. In the heat of the battle, the Cloud of Monstrox sees the stone statue of Clay and zaps him to life! Clay is now turned, and is fighting against his friends. It is impossible for them to defeat him without destroying him for good. The Cloud urges Clay on. He attacks the Fortrex in order to get to Merlok. Robin in his Black Knight Mech is trying to stop him, but to no avail. Merlok 2.0 is left undefended. At the very last moment Merlok 2.0 unleashes a blasting spell that sends Clay far far away.

programme.title: The Good, The Bad And The Tightwad
programme.desc: Clay wakes up in the poor town of Nothing Hill which literally have nothing. Will Clay remember who he is and what he is fighting for. His friends try to help him, but Jorah Tightwad and his Bots get in the way. Clay as the Gray Knight wakes up far away in a place called Nothing Hill. A poor town where they literally have nothing. They harvest dust. Jorah Tightwad though has found that there is gold underneath the town. He convinces the confused Clay to help him put pressure on the poor townsfolk to give up their lots. This is an easy job for the strong Gray Knight. The NEXO KNIGHTS finally track him down and tries to convince him about who he is. But to the Gray Knight they are still his enemies, and a giant battle ensues in order to subdue the Gray Knight. At last, only Macy is left. When she begins to recite the Knights Code, some words and their meaning are able to get through the stone hard shell of the Gray Knight and the Evil that clouded him seems to disappear. Together they are able to return the ownership of the town to the villagers.

programme.title: The Book Of Monsters, Part 1
programme.desc: When Jestro the Jester finds the Book of Monsters, chaos breaks loose in the Kingdom of Knighton. Can the newly graduated Knights from the Knights' Academy save the kingdom? It's final graduation fighting exams for the latest Knights from Knights' Academy. All our new Knights demonstrate their prowess: CLAY, AARON, AXL and LANCE. PRINCESS MACY get to join them, but her father doesn't want her to graduate. As part of the entertainment, MERLOK does an amazing magic trick. His act is followed by…JESTRO, the King's Jester. He's terrible (and he should know to never follow a better act.) Everyone laughed because he's a real joke....a total failure. While Jestro roams the halls fo the King's Castle, forlorn, he hears the BOOK OF MONSTERS calling to him from Merlok's library. The book talks Jestro into gathering as many books of spells as he can carry, but they're interrupted by...Clay! As Jestro quickly pages through the Book of Monsters to attack Clay, Merlok arrives. There's a battle in the library between Jestro and Merlok. Finally, the wizard summons up his most powerful spell in self-defence. BOOM! There's a big, magical explosion and when Clay forces his way back into the library, Merlok, Jestro and the magic books are...GONE!

programme.title: The Book Of Monsters, Part 2
programme.desc: Realizing they must defend the Kingdom from Jestro's monsters, the Knights try to organize but are despondent when they discover their best advisor – Merlok the Magician – has sacrificed himself to save them. When Jestro awakens, he's been blasted miles and miles away from the King's Castle by Merlok's explosive spell. And, it seems, all the books he was trying to steal have been scattered, too. The Book of Monsters broke Jestro' fall and now he can use the book to attack the people who laughed at him. Meanwhile, the King and his newly-trained Knights pick through the rubble of Merlok's library. They'll have to figure something out, because Jestro and his newly made magic monsters attack King's Castle! Clay organizes the Knights to defend the kingdom, but they've never worked together before. It takes all their training, plus the help of an old friend…MERLOK! Only now he's MERLOK 2.0. Ava has been piecing together what happened and discovering that the “ghost in the machine” she's been chasing is really Merlok in digital form. Now, he can use his magic digitally and he downloads just the right weapons to the struggling Knights! They finally foil Jestro's attack with Merlok's help and officially become NEXO KNIGHTS!

programme.title: Tailor's Magic Needle
programme.desc: Tailor Smurf has to make an outfit for every Smurf before the Fall fashion show. Brainy Smurf wants to help him and, using Papa Smurf's book of Magic, he conjures up a magic needle that sews ten times faster than tailor... But is it really any good?

programme.title: The Smurfs
programme.desc: The Smurfs - The Memory Melon: Selwyn and Tallulah are two powerful married wizards. The trouble is, they fight all the time. But the energy from their arguments is brewing up a dreadful storm and Papa has to get them to make up before the storm starts to rage.

programme.title: The Smurfs
programme.desc: The Smurfs - A Smurf For Denisa: Balthazar brings Denisa to Gargamel to baby-sit. But Gargamel loses Denisa in the wood and she and Sassette meet and become friends. Sassette and Denisa work together to free the Smurfs from Gargamel's stewpot, and prove you don't have to be big to be brave.

programme.title: The Smurfs
programme.desc: The Smurfs - Peewit's Unscrupulous Adventure: Peewit, the court jester, is the Smurfs' human friend. There is to be a celebration at the King's castle and Peewit good-humouredly invites his little blue friends to the feast. But they learn that the wicked chamberlain is pilfering the King's possessions.

programme.title: The Smurfiest Of Friends
programme.desc: Brainy Smurf had one friend: Clumsy Smurf. But poor Clumsy is so, well, clumsy, that Brainy refuses to see him again. So now he is left without anyone willing to listen to him. Maybe Buddy, the good-looking imp met by chance near the Great Oak can be a pal for Brainy....

programme.title: The Smurfs
programme.desc: The Smurfs - Poltersmurf: There are few things Grandpa Smurf enjoys more than telling a good scary story, and there are few Smurfs who don't love to listen. But things get a little too much for Brainy Smurf when Grandpa tells of Poltersmurfs, and Poltersmurfs begin harrowing Brainy...

programme.title: The Smurfs
programme.desc: The Smurfs - Greedy And The Porridge Pot: The good fairy, Guinilda gives Greedy a magic porridge pot that Brainy causes to overflow into the village and forest. The good-hearted fairy hurries to the rescue and then asks for the pot back to give to an orphanage of hungry children.

programme.title: The Smurfs
programme.desc: The Smurfs - The Most Unsmurfy Games: To prove the worth of his Big Book of Wilderness Survival, Brainy takes the Smurflings to the swamp. Where, thanks to his expert advice, the tiny group gets totally lost, is then caught in quicklime and trapped by King Bullrush of the Wartmongers. Fortunately, Bullrush is in a playful mood and devises a Smurf hunt. Unfortunately, Brainy believes he is a born leader...

programme.title: Smurf Box Derby
programme.desc: Handy Smurf makes another invention: the Smurfmobile. Each Smurf has his – or her – customized vehicle and all, or almost all, the Smurfs enjoy a little spin... But then the evil wizard Gargamel gets hold of the idea and starts making trouble for the Smurfs...

programme.title: The Smurfs
programme.desc: The Smurfs - The Noble Stag: His wicked cousin, Malcolm the Mean, who plans to kill him and mount him in his trophy room, has turned King Gerard into a black stag. The little Smurfs help their friend. When King Gerard is transformed back into his human form, Malcolm becomes imprisoned in the body of the stag.

programme.title: The Smurfs
programme.desc: The Smurfs - Curried Smurfs: In Ancient India, the unscrupulous fakir Gargapuri sells the Smurfs to the Rajah for his private zoo. Only Grandpa, Wild Smurf and Jokey are free, so it's up to them to sneak into the palace and rescue their friends. Along the way they free all the caged animals in the Raja's menagerie.

programme.title: The Smurfs
programme.desc: The Smurfs - Hopping Cough Smurfs: The evil wizard Gargamel spreads the forest with the germs of the uncontrollable hopping cough. Baby Smurf is the first victim and all the Village of the Smurfs goes frantic with worry... Fortunately, Papa Smurf thinks there might be a cure.

programme.title: The Smurfs
programme.desc: The Smurfs - The Sorcerer Smurf: Gargamel creates the legend of Sorcerer Smurf to lure Papa Smurf and his smurfy friends into a trap at his mountain hideaway. Papa Smurf outwits the wicked wizard with some of his own magic and Gargamel is chased down the mountain and back to his castle.

programme.title: The Smurfs
programme.desc: The Smurfs - The Smurf Who Would Be King: Dreamy yearns to be King after reading a story about them. He falls through a whirlpool while on his ship and finds himself in the land of pokies who think Dreamy is their long-lost King. When he confronts the pokies' enemies, the Norfnags, he finds they aren't fearful at all. Dreamy bumps his head and wakes up to discover it was just a dream, yet finds a jewel in his cap, just like the ones the pokies mine for a living.

programme.title: The Smurfs
programme.desc: The Smurfs - April Smurf's Day: April Smurf's Day turns out to be not so funny when Gargamel dons a smurfberry bush disguise to capture the happy little Smurfs. Papa Smurf instructs Feathers to call the birds to attack the fake bush. After it is stripped, the captured Smurfs climb aboard Feathers and fly away.

programme.title: Beauty Is Only Smurf Deep
programme.desc: Periwinkle, a vain Pixie, is upset when her magic mirror tells her that Vanity is the fairest, not she. Periwinkle kidnaps Vanity, but the rest of the Smurfs come to Vanity's rescue. Periwinkle sees the error of her ways and they become friends.

programme.title: The Smurfs

programme.title: The Tops and the Roots
programme.desc: There was a village and a man, living in this village. In a deep forest near that village, the Bear settled in. The Bear asked the man for some tasty treats. The man gave the Bear two options of what he prefers to eat: the tops or the roots. The Bear decided to take the tops. The man grew a turnip and gave the tops to the Bear. The tops were tasteless. The Bear asked the man to try the turnip. The man agreed on the condition that the Bear will help him with the housework and keep off the flies. While chasing away the flies, the Bear accidentally hit the man on the nose. The Bear was scared and ran away into the forest, grabbing the turnip with him. Since then, people use to say “to be a fool for one's pains”.

programme.title: Ali Baba
programme.desc: This story is about one very kind, but very poor Ali-Baba and his rich but greedy brother Kasym. Once upon a time Ali-Baba overheard the magic spell, which opens up the magic cape with numerous treasures. These treasures were stolen by the thieves and kept in this cave. One day Ali-Baba met Kasym and told him the secret spell. Kasym got inside the cape, but accidentally forgot the spell and the thieves caught him. They forced Kasym to learn the whole book of fairy tales by heart and spend one thousand days and a thousand and one nights telling these stories to them. This story teaches us to study well and avoid cheating.

programme.title: The Wolf and the Fox
programme.desc: Once upon a time there lived a fisherman with his wife. Nearby there lived the Fox. One day the man went to a frozen pond to fish. On his way he found the Fox, who pretended to be dead, and picked her up. The Man started to fish and fell asleep over an ice-hole. The Wolf saw this and was glad as he hoped to get some fish, but the Fox told the Wolf that it's her own fisherman and if he wants to eat some fish - he should put in his own tail in an ice-hole. The Wolf's tail froze in the ice and fishes made a cute Christmas tree out of it. The Man, his Wife, the Fox, the Cat and the Mouse finally pulled the Wolf's tail out of the hole and the New Year has finally come.

programme.title: Tom Thumb
programme.desc: This is a story about the small but brave boy. The moral of the story is that no matter how big and tall you are, you should not offend the little ones. It may happen so that you will meet some tom thumb boy, who will beat any “giant”.

programme.title: Wee Little Havroshechka
programme.desc: There lived a woman who had three daughters - two of her own and the stepdaughter called Wee Little Havroshechka. She loved her own daughters and hated the stepdaughter who was forced to work till dawn. No matter how hard she tried to please the stepmother, she was unapproachable. Once upon a time the stepmother kicked her out of the house, but every medal has its flipside – Wee Little Havroshechka met her Prince and they lived happily ever after, and it's all because she was hard-working and clean.

programme.title: Quartet Plus
programme.desc: To play in a quartet is not so easy as it seems, especially if there is no slack between musicians. This is what Masha tells Papa Bear, who came to visit. And he will tell about Bear's childhood and how he was mischievous with the Himalayan bear. Has anything changed since then? We will learn it from the new episode. And most importantly, music will unite everyone!

programme.title: Tour de Forest
programme.desc: Himalayan Bear is once again competing with Bear! This time they have arranged a bike race, but something doesn't smell right: Himalayan Bear intends on cheating to win! Good thing Masha stands as a guardian of justice and always comes to a friend's aid!

programme.title: What's Inside?
programme.desc: "What is inside such seemingly simple objects surrounding us? How are the mechanisms that we use every day arranged? Maybe they work with the help of magic? Or maybe each system has a certain order?In this episode, Masha decides to figure out how the objects surrounding her are arranged. And in the company of an old friend, this research becomes an adventure. "

programme.title: Try, Try Again
programme.desc: A van with Monkeys arrived at the Bear's house. They invite everyone to test themselves with the help of an attraction - a power meter. The Bear is confident that he will easily win the main prize. But things didn't go according to plan. And now the main strongman of the forest cannot do without the help of his friends.

programme.title: Princess and the Beast
programme.desc: Shocking and sensation! For the first time in our forest! A couple of tourists broke into the Bear's house without an invitation in search of impressions and cool photos. And there they are - just a sleepy Bear and Masha, who really wants to play. Rejoice tourists! You will have impressions, photos, and obstacle course from here and to the city itself!

programme.title: First Day Of School
programme.desc: With the beginning of September, Masha, like all the children wants to go to school and asks the Bear to make her one. Overwhelmed with enthu-siasm, the Bear completes the task and the next day Masha sits at a brand new desk and tries to act as an attentive student but ends up bringing the Bear to absolute madness.

programme.title: Fishy story
programme.desc: Summer is a time of rest and miracles. How nice is just to sit on the river bank with your best friends! However, everything is not so simple in our story. The Bear didn't even suspect what kind of adventure he was going to find on his fishing trip. While Masha and She-Bear frightened by his sudden disappearance, explore the neighborhood, he ... however, you will find out everything yourself in our new episode.

programme.title: Don't Wake Till Spring!
programme.desc: The autumn has arrived. The Bear prepares for his winter bedtime by barricading himself from Masha inside the house. But the little girl manages to find her way indoors and causes yet another mess by awakening a whole swarm of bees. But all her games eventually stop and when the Bear cooks some porridge to feed the child, he discovers her fallen asleep.

programme.title: A Ghost Story
programme.desc: At first time in her life Masha is frightened in earnest, however this creepy story shook up the whole forest and now hardly anyone can stay away from these strange scenes! And what would you do if your own pillow and blanket turn into real ghosts?! A real ghost story, oh yeah!

programme.title: The Very Fairy Tale
programme.desc: Masha loves fairy tales and of course she believes that each fairy tale should lead to happy end, even if nothing contributes to it! That's how the story goes… The Bear still hopes to win the heart of the female Bear. He finds an ancient gondola at the bottom of the forest lake. The Bear decides to restore it and invites the female Bear for a romantic ride! No one would have expected that this story would perfectly match Masha's new hobby - puppet theatre.

programme.title: Time To Ride My Pony
programme.desc: The Bear's good friend, the Tiger, is back for a visit and they decide to spend the time together in an intellectual way – playing chess. Masha is immediately drawn into the game and to everyone's surprise, she outsmarts and outplays both the Bear and his friend with just one chess figure.

programme.title: The Grand Piano Lesson
programme.desc: The bear finds a beautiful black piano in the forest. He happily takes it home, fixes and tunes it and begins to play some music. Masha couldn't help staying away from this lovely instrument. She decides to become a world famous pianist, she asks the Bear to teach her how to play the piano.

programme.title: Arts and Crafts Day
programme.desc: Masha announces Arts and Crafts Day. Get your glue, pencils and any unnecessary things and let's create! The Bear is trying to sneak away on a fishing trip. But what will he catch if all his floats are gone for crafts? Is it Masha, to put her in a corner? Well, not this time. Friendship always wins in our creative contests!

programme.title: The Foundling
programme.desc: Occasionally Masha finds an egg, from which a penguin hatches. The Bear has to take double care now. He cooks special dishes and builds mini aqua park for little penguin and Masha. Finally the Bear figures out that the penguin will be happy only in suitable weather conditions and send the penguin Antarctica on a little plane.

programme.title: See You Later
programme.desc: This day will change Bear's life forever. To everyone's surprise, Masha has suddenly grown up, getting all the forest dwellers shocked by her exceptionally good behavior. Her sister Dasha is going to take her back to the big city, which really upsets the Bear and others.

programme.title: Sleeping Beauties
programme.desc: Masha is the best "mommy" in the world, but even she can not put Rosy to sleep. Bear offers a solution: a music box. And everything would have been fine, but the music box suddenly turns out to hold a surprise inside it!

programme.title: We Come In Peace!
programme.desc: In the courtyard of the Bear's house a spaceship makes an emergency landing. The aliens need to urgently replenish their supplies and return home. Only on the ground everything is arranged differently than at home. Masha and Mishka will help them to understand what's what, fix the ship and go back to home.

programme.title: Scary Story About Spooky Stories
programme.desc: Are you sure that you really like spooky stories? What if this kind of story will get you really thrilled? Listen to one classic story and don't say that you are not shocked after all!

programme.title: Soul Freezing Tale Of Grim Forest And Tiny Timid Bug
programme.desc: All children are afraid of the dark. Masha was afraid of it too and had to sit with a torch all night long! But once upon a time she came up with the tale about a tiny bug, which lived in the woods and was so afraid of the dark, that every rustle made its heart tremble! The bug suffered a lot until he realized that all tiny things you see in the dark just seem to be frightful and fear makes no sense at all!

programme.title: Terrible Truth About Those Who Are Afraid To Be Little
programme.desc: Everyone think that it's so scary to be little as there are so many things are not accessible for you! But in reality there is no difference how little you are if there is someone who cares for you and someone you care about…

programme.title: Gloomy Story About The Darkest Dreams
programme.desc: All children are keen on computer games! Everyone likes to shoot a couple of monsters before going to sleep. Tolik also liked to play shooters until the monsters attack him in reality in order to commit the revenge! Or…was it just a dream? Let's see...

programme.title: Sinister Saga Of A Sick Tummy And A Girl Who Was Afraid Of Doctors
programme.desc: Masha narrates a terrific story about one little girl who was afraid of doctors. And once upon a time she experienced one fantastic story…she decided to cook dinner for her dolls. She took some clay and made “meat balls” with “semolina porridge”. As the meal seemed tasty, Sima decided to eat a bit of her dinner too… And so she lies in her bad and feels a horrible stomachache. Nobody knows how long she would need to suffer, but when she woke up…she realized herself in hospital…near the real snow queen… who explained that medical treatment is not scary at all…though some other things are very fearsome! Oh yeah!

programme.title: Bloodcurdling Saga About Joyful Event
programme.desc: Everyone think that it's so scary to be little as there are so many things are not accessible for you! But in reality there is no difference how little you are if there is someone who cares for you and someone you care about…

programme.title: Grim Parable About Superstitious Girl
programme.desc: Some people happen to believe in all sorts of omens like black cats, wearing clothes inside out, prophetic dreams… Poor girl Lucy believed in that kind of stuff so much that was even afraid to go outside to play with her friends. And how could you go out if you were born in the year of Purple rabbit that promises…no matter what… You'll see…

programme.title: Terrifying True Story About Monsters And Those Who Fear Them
programme.desc: Are you afraid of monsters? Sure you are! Let me tell you a scary story about a boy who experienced a real fear…This story happened on an abandoned tractor factory. The boy lost a scoop from his toy-tractor and decided to look for it at the factory. So he goes up the stairs and sees a large female monster, who was about to paint her lips with a roller! As he kept walking he noticed more monsters playing domino! The boy was very terrified and about to cry, when he learnt that it was just a movie set and all the monsters were not real! They were just actors…Finally the boy realized that all the monsters from the books and movies are not real at all! But if want to see a real monster- watch a fly under a microscope!

programme.title: The Wolf and the Fox
programme.desc: Once upon a time there lived a fisherman with his wife. Nearby there lived the Fox. One day the man went to a frozen pond to fish. On his way he found the Fox, who pretended to be dead, and picked her up. The Man started to fish and fell asleep over an ice-hole. The Wolf saw this and was glad as he hoped to get some fish, but the Fox told the Wolf that it's her own fisherman and if he wants to eat some fish - he should put in his own tail in an ice-hole. The Wolf's tail froze in the ice and fishes made a cute Christmas tree out of it. The Man, his Wife, the Fox, the Cat and the Mouse finally pulled the Wolf's tail out of the hole and the New Year has finally come.

programme.title: The Wolf and the Seven Young Kids
programme.desc: This educative tale teaches us that caution should never be dismissed. Mother-Goat goes to pick up cabbage, leaving her seven kids alone at home. Hungry Wolf tries to get into the house imitating mother Goat's voice to fool the little yeanlings. He manages to deceive six kids, but the seventh, the smallest one, manages to hide in the oven. The Wolf tries to get into the house through the chimney, but here comes Mother-Goat and finds her seventh kid. She melts the stove, and the Wolf rushes into the forest with his tail burnt. The other six kids come back home and finally the family reunites.

programme.title: The Fox and the Rolling Pin
programme.desc: This is the story about the Fox, the Cat and the Rooster. The sneaky Fox wanted to fool the Cat in order to eat the Rooster and get a rolling-pin. No matter how the Fox tried to butter up the Cat, he denied hand over the Rooster to the Fox. To teach her a lesson, the Cat got into a bag himself and when the Fox opened it in order to eat the Rooster, the Cat jumped out of it and frightened her. The point of the story is that “if you are well off you don't seek better”.

programme.title: Go I Know Not Whither
programme.desc: Once upon a time there was a king. He was very cranky and foolish. One day he wished to taste an exotic fowl and sent Yegor the huntsman to the deep forest. In the forest, Yegor met a starling, which turned into a beautiful girl. The Tsar saw Yegor to have successfully completed his task and also got the beautiful wife. He started to envy Yegor. The Tsar decided to send Yegor over distant seas to bring do not know what. Despite Tsar's insidious plan, Yegor has successfully returned back home and even taught the king an important lesson not to envy other people.

programme.title: The Frog Princess
programme.desc: There lived a Tsar with his three sons. The oldest son married on nobleman's daughter, the second one married the merchant's daughter, while the youngest son - on the Frog. She was not pretty, but happened to be the Frog Princess who turned into a beautiful girl. This story teaches us to take care of your pets. This is the only way they could appeal to your concerns and become your faithful friends.

programme.title: Liar, Liar, Pants On Fire
programme.desc: Kids love daydreaming and show off their imaginary successes, aren't they?! Masha and Panda grip into a real cheating competition! This would be very funny story If only all the secrets were not revealed all at the most inopportune time!

programme.title: Laundry Day
programme.desc: The Bear decides to suit a big laundry in his yard, but yet he has no idea that soon he would have to pull Masha from a puddle and a jar of jam. But it's not all- now the Bear has to sew new dresses eve-ry time when Masha will get wet or dirty.

programme.title: All You Need is a Goal
programme.desc: The ball is on the field, the players are in the field, the Bear in the chair is rooting for his favorite team. But Masha got bored in anticipation of a goal. Why wait when there is a team in the yard, and everyone needs a goal so much!

programme.title: La Dolce Vita
programme.desc: Masha wants some sweets but first she has to transform the Bear's kitchen into a candy-making factory. As we all know, such sweet life means trouble and soon Masha gets a toothache. There is a lesson for all children who love sweets - take very good care of your teeth!

programme.title: Princess or Dragon?
programme.desc: A snow tower? Check. A group of friends? Check. Sound like a recipe for a fun game! Even Bear caved to the pressure and joined Masha, Rosie and Penguin – what wouldn't you do for the sake of the children! But who will be the Princess? And who will be the Dragon? And the knight and his brave steed? Masha has her own opinion on these questions…

programme.title: Well-beeing
programme.desc: What happens when bees overeat chocolates? Masha becomes their personal trainer! Get ready! Let's start weight loss exercises!

programme.title: How to Train Your Plant
programme.desc: She-Bear is going to a resort and leaves Bear with her “pet” – a flycatcher. The modest flower suddenly shows an excellent appetite. Masha, of course, knows better than anyone how to treat the flycatcher. She-Bear will be surprised when she returns to the forest and sees what came out of such a “feeding”!

programme.title: Recipe For Disaster
programme.desc: The Bear plays checkers. Masha interrupts him asking to feed her. The Bear cooks some porridge for her. But Masha doesn't like it. The Bear goes off in a huff. Masha decides to cook porridge her-self. But soon the porridge swells out. All the for-est inhabitants will remember this day for long…

programme.title: I'M LIVE
programme.desc: Joining us on this week's I'm LIVE is the duo HOONS! HOONS is composed of two musicians of the same age - vocalist Lee Sang-hoon and keyboardist Lee Jong-hoon. They met each other in university and then made their debut together in 2016 with the single To You I Am. Thanks to their soft mellow music and sweet lyrics the duo mesmerized the public immediately and they are certainly making their way in the music industry building their fanbase and having their music featured in various TV shows. In this episode HOONS performs I C U Can't hide a love and many others to showcase the essence of their musicality. Tune in to I'm LIVE and meet the duo!

programme.title: I'M LIVE
programme.desc: Joining us on this week's I'm LIVE is the Korean father of city pop - Kim Hyun-chul! Kim Hyun-chul made his debut in 1989 with the album Kim Hyun-chul Vol. 1. With all songs composed written and arranged by the artist himself he pleasantly surprised the ears and souls of listeners with his jazz-infused music and eventually brought a new wave to the Korean music scene. Throughout his 32-year career Kim Hyun-chul gained much critical acclaim and commercial success earning the nickname the father of Korean city pop. Also his debut album was chosen as one of the All-Time 100 Greatest Albums of Korean Popular Music thanks to the influence it had had on the Korean music scene. Then in 2019 Kim Hyun-chul resumed his career after a break of 13 years and in celebration of the 30th anniversary of his debut. The album garnered much attention not only because of the anticipation of fans and critics but also because he brought an array of Korea's leading artists along with him. His return coincided with the resurgence of city pop in Korea and he's back once again 2 years later in 2021 to continue with the momentum. Part I of Kim Hyun-chul's performance on I'm LIVE features What's the Matter? City Breeze & Love Song and Tears of Joy. Tune in to the show and meet the legend!

programme.title: Yam Kisi Se Kam Nahin
programme.desc: A misfit, a God, a husband, and a breadwinner, Yamraj is a common man with a fancy job title. He tries his best to give his family what they need and manages to make a mess of everything in the bargain. Lovable and goofy, this God of Death is anything but grim. Join our hardworking but hen-pecked Yamraj, his beloved buffalo and his motely family and friends in a slice-of-life sitcom to find out how the cookie really crumbles!

programme.title: Dahej Daasi
programme.desc: This story is about a 19yr old girl named Chunari, who dreams of marriage and a happy family. However, she becomes entangled in the chains of deceit, finding herself on the path to becoming a Dahej Dasi, which is a tradition still prevalent in the backward regions of Rajasthan. The show unfolds into a compelling drama of tradition versus rebellion, love versus oppression.

programme.title: Agni Vayu
programme.desc: Agni Vayu Is A Romantic Thriller That Tells The Story Of A Young, Vibrant Dr. Agni And An Ambitious Investment Banker Vayu. As Their Love Blossoms, An Unfortunate Turn Of Events Happens That Throws Them Amid Conspiracy, Misunderstanding, Swindling, And All Sorts Of Paradoxes At Every Turn. They Set Out On A Journey To Unravel The Mystery Surrounding These Events. Can They Both Solve It Together And Will They Disclose Their Feelings To Each Other During The Journey.

programme.title: Laal Banarasi
programme.desc: The story highlights the exploitation happening with the ‘Bunkars' in Banaras, whose craft is appreciated all around the world, but they are paid peanuts by the traders. Amidst this, blooms a love story between the two opposites - Gauri, a bunkar and Garv, a trader. The story is of Gauri who belongs to the bunkar community facing series of incidents which destroys her family and swears to bring about a change in their life and stop the exploitation by directly trading the sarees. This becomes a battle with traders creating hurdles in her life but she is unstoppable.

programme.title: Mid
programme.desc: Veteran actor, Naseeruddin Shah, explores the many untold stories of Indian cricket. He recalls the history of the game match highlights. Sportsmanship, stadiums, hits and misses, and many more. In his unique narrative style, Naseeruddin Shah brings alive the humorous side of the game, along with undocumented anecdotes and quirky trivia. The show also features many personalities who narrate cricketing experiences and stories including Shashi Tharoor, Narl Contractor, Bishan Singh Bedi and Charu Sharma amongst others

programme.title: Epic Ke Dus
programme.desc: Epic Ke Dus is a halfhour collated list of the top ten people, places or events of a chosen topic, examples of which include rivalries, thinkers and warriors. Each topic has been thoroughly researched and a panel of experts on the subject has carefully selected the stories that are fitting to be part of the topic. This panel is seen on the episodes giving their views on the events, the significance of the event and describing the mood of the era, publics reaction to these events and how it contributed to change the course of Indian history.

programme.title: Sharanam
programme.desc: Sharanam takes viewers on a poignant journey to some of the most revered pilgrimage sites in India to and highlights the traditions, practices, rituals and ideals that bring people to these holy places in search of something greater than themselves. Narrated by Bollywood actress Juhi Chawla, Sharanam showcases testimonies of personal incidents that are the bedrock of the belief, and follows the strong thread of faith that not only binds the pilgrims to their Gods, but also the nation with itself.

programme.title: Lost Recipes
programme.desc: Lost Recipes is all about the food which is diffused into the pages of history and the rediscovery of a tradition that once was. Our host Aditya Bal is on a quest to unearth the once-popular culinary traditions through thirteen regions in India.But these recipes are no longer found in cookbooks, old or new, and seem to have evolved with time. Aditya must turn back the clock and wade through folk and lore to find the original, Lost Recipes.

programme.title: Raja Rasoi Aur Andaaz Anokha
programme.desc: After the resounding success of the first two seasons, EPIC Channel presents a revamped avatar of its Raja Rasoi series. EPIC Channel's Raja Rasoi series - titled Raja Rasoi Aur Andaaz Anokha - stands true to its name. While the lore and love of Indian food remains just as passionate, the new season presents a discovery oriented show format that transforms table-top cooking into an exciting food lab. Featuring renowned chef Ranveer Brar, the show will take you to his retreat – an old-world bungalow basking in the laidback vibe of Goa and then along on a ride nostalgia and rediscovery both personal and culinary. Ranveer's passion for culinary art makes him a perfect fit as the host for the latest season of the food series. He has dedicated this experimental streak and passion for food to his mentor – Munir Ahmed, a quaint, ordinary yet passionate food enthusiast from the gullies of Lucknow who greatly influenced Brar while growing up in his hometown.

programme.title: Mercedes-Benz DRIVE PILOT Sensors S-Class
programme.desc: The exact location of a Mercedes equipped with DRIVE PILOT is determined using a high-precision positioning system that is much more powerful than conventional GPS systems. In addition to the anonymised data collected by LiDAR, camera, radar and ultrasound sensors, a digital HD map provides a three-dimensional image of the road and the surroundings with information on road geometry, route characteristics, traffic signs and special traffic events (e.g. accidents or road works). This high-precision map differs from maps for navigation devices by, among other things, its higher accuracy in the centimetre rather than metre range and its detailed junction and route model. The map data is stored in backend data centres and updated constantly. Each vehicle also stores an image of this map information on board, constantly compares it with the backend data and updates the local dataset as required. All of this enables stable and accurate positioning through a representation of the surroundings that is independent of factors such as shadows or dirty sensors.

programme.title: Kia Sportage Exterior Design in Lunar Silver
programme.desc: A number of new technologies optimize the precision and control of the chassis in a wide variety of weather and road conditions. The standard electronic damper control (Electronic Control Suspension, ECS) in the GT-line version increases comfort and safety thanks to the continuous damping control. The system reacts to body movements and steering inputs and changes the damping behavior at lightning speed in order to counteract the vehicle's diving, pitching and rolling movements when cornering. It also adjusts the damping force in the case of obstacles in order to cope with them as comfortably as possible and to reduce the influence of post-vibrations on the wheels. A premiere for the Sportage is the “All-Terrain-Mode”, which will be available for the plug-in hybrid version with all-wheel drive. The system offers intelligent support when driving off-road or on snow by automatically optimizing the vehicle settings depending on the selected mode and thus helping the SUV to achieve maximum traction on muddy, sandy or snowy surfaces.

programme.title: Colour change with the power of thought
programme.sub-title: The BMW iX Flow meets neuro-technology
programme.desc: The Munich-based startup brainboost used the new and improved colour-changing effect in a one-off collaboration with the BMW Group at rad°hub aimed at raising awareness of mental health. With the help of brainboost, the BMW iX Flow was connected directly to the brain of the rad°hub delegates using an electroencephalograph (EEG), which records the brain's electrical activity. “The colour patterns of the BMW iX Flow react to brain activity and reflect the level of activity,” explains brainboost CEO Philipp Heiler. “Once the brain is at rest, the changes of patterns on the iX Flow also become calmer and more rhythmical.” A special animation was activated if delegates managed to maintain this state for several seconds. Thus, the participants were able to gradually calm and relax their brains under the guidance of the brainboost experts and with the help of neurofeedback via the iX Flow. This matures the knowledge of which strategies work best to specifically shut down one's own brain activity for relaxation, e.g. in everyday working life.

programme.title: Alvin Superstar

Tre forze della natura che, oltre a devastargli la casa, distruggergli la carriera e stravolgergli completamente la vita, si rivelano una band musicale strepitosa.

programme.title: Dubitando Di Thomas

programme.title: I Puffi

programme.desc: S1:E57 La festa sonnacchiosa per Pigrone | L'invenzione delle Puffmobili - Quattrocchi sfida Tuffy a dipingere le unghie dei piedi di Bocca Grande al pigiamino party di Pigrone. | I Puffi organizzano una gara automobilistica per determinare il miglior modello di automobile per il super impegnato Inventore.

programme.desc: S1:E58 La crema Puffa| Incontri ravvicinati di Puffo-tipo - Inventore e Golosone aprono una gelateria. | Degli alieni chiamati Grimeys sono bloccati vicino al Villaggio dei Puffi finché non riparano la loro nave rotta

programme.title: I Puffi
programme.sub-title: S1:E59 Il mago alato | Il primo Telepuffo
programme.desc: S1:E59 Il mago alato | Il primo Telepuffo - Gargamella consulta il suo Grande Grimorio Magico, un'opera che ha risposta a tutto, per scoprire un modo per sorvolare il villaggio dei Puffi. | Un prodotto magico di Grande Puffo trasforma una pianta di melone e una liana selvatica, che cresce a una velocità fenomenale.

programme.title: I Puffi
programme.sub-title: S1:E60 Gli Zuffi Pasticcioni | Non E' Puffo Tutto Cio Che Luccica
programme.desc: S1:E60 Gli Zuffi Pasticcioni | Non E' Puffo Tutto Cio Che Luccica - Tontolone trova nella foresta uno Zuffo. Sembra una creaturina innocua e per questo decide di portarlo al villaggio. | Gargamella riesce a catturare dieci Puffi per preparare una pozione magica che transforma i metalli in oro.

programme.title: Sorbole… che romagnola
programme.desc: Cult della commedia all'italiana . Una avvenente guida turistica romagnola, per l'errore di un'agenzia, è costretta a pagare un conto salatissimo nell'albergo dove alloggia. Essendo al verde, si reinventa dietologa, aiutando le mogli trascurate degli abitanti del luogo a tornare in forma.

programme.title: Letti sbagliati
programme.desc: Franco Franchi, Ciccio Ingrassia, Raimondo Vianello e Aldo Giuffrè in una commedia scoppiettante. Quattro divertenti episodi che ruotano intorno al piacere: due sono ambientati in un treno, all'interno del quale si verificano eventi indimenticabili, uno in un caldo ascensore bloccato e l'ultimo riguarda un vedovo, ossessionato dal precedente matrimonio.

programme.title: Letti selvaggi
programme.desc: Commedia all'italiana con un cast d'eccezione tra cui Monica Vitti, Roberto Benigni, Ursula Andress e Michele Placido. Otto episodi intrecciano storie di seduzione, tradimenti ed equivoci che celebrano la comicità del periodo tra desideri proibiti e amori clandestini.

programme.title: Nel giorno del signore
programme.desc: Margherita, soprannominata Fornarina, è l'amante di Raffaello. Beatrice, una nobildonna innamorata del famoso pittore, cerca di toglierla di mezzo, facendola accusare ingiustamente dell'omicidio di uno strozzino, che in realtà ha ucciso lei stessa. Fornarina viene condannato a morte. Riuscirà Raffaello a dimostrarla innocente?

programme.title: La donna della domenica
programme.desc: Un Classico del cinema italiano, diretto da Luigi Comencini e interpretato da Marcello Mastroianni e Jean-louis Trintignant. A Torino viene misteriosamente ucciso un architetto. Le indagini portano il commissario Santamaria a indirizzare i suoi sospetti su alcuni esponenti dell'alta società, e in particolare su Anna, moglie di un grosso industriale, e sul suo confidente, un dottore.

programme.title: I ragazzi dei Parioli
programme.desc: Una storia sui giovani della classe borghese italiana degli anni Sessanta e sui loro modi di impiegare il tempo.

programme.title: Il brigadiere Pasquale Zagaria ama la mamma e la polizia
programme.desc: Primo film da protagonista di Lino Banfi. Degradato e infine espulso dalla polizia per inettitudine comprovata, il brigadiere pugliese Pasquale Zagaria si ritira a vita privata nella campagna romana. Ma ben presto resta coinvolto in un oscuro traffico di diamanti. Con l'aiuto della vigorosa moglie Pupetta, cintura nera di karate, Zagaria torna ad affrontare i delinquenti.

programme.title: Accadde al commissariato
programme.desc: Capolavoro della commedia italiana con Nino Taranto, Alberto Sordi e Walter Chiari. Cosa potrebbe accadere a Roma in un commissariato di Polizia nell'arco di 24 ore? Compagnie teatrali sul lastrico, matrimoni in crisi, bambini abbandonati e oltraggi al senso del pudore, animano la vita dell'ufficio, impegnando il commissario, che vorrebbe trovare del tempo per dedicarsi alla sua nuova automobile.

programme.title: Il vedovo
programme.desc: Splendida commedia italiana diretta da Dino Risi e interpretata dal mitico Alberto Sordi. Un romano trapiantato a Milano, che s'è sposato solo per interesse, crede a un certo punto che la ricchissima moglie sia morta in un incidente e pensa già a come adoperare i suoi milioni. La donna, invece, è viva. Il poveraccio prepara un piano per farla fuori ma accadrà qualcosa di veramente inaspettato.

programme.title: La grande abbuffata
programme.desc: In una villa fuori Parigi quattro vecchi amici si riuniscono per un week-end abbandonandosi ad un`orgia di cibo e sesso. Uno di loro, Marcello, porta con sé alcune prostitute che disgustate dall`ambiente se ne andranno. Ad un certo punto una maestra va lì per caso con in suoi alunni in visita al giardino della villa, rimane affascinata dai quattro e decide di fare ritorno unendosi a loro nel folle e autodistruttivo fine settimana...

programme.title: Rappresaglia
programme.desc: Roma 23 Marzo 1944. Le truppe tedesche tengono la città sotto il loro controllo. In seguito ad un attentato contro una compagnia delle SS compiuto in via Rasella, il generale Maelzer informa i suoi capi a Berlino che, decisi ad abrogare qualunque soglia di tolleranza, ordinano una veloce rappresaglia, pretendendo l`esecuzione di dieci italiani per ogni tedesco ucciso. Sarà il tenente colonnello Herbert Kapller a gestire l`intervento e a compilare la lista dei sacrificati, nonostante il suo aperto dissenso.

programme.title: Vita da cani
programme.desc: Tre ragazze condividono un sogno: fare fortuna. Franca è occupata in una fabbrica ed stanca di fare la vita dell`operaia: abbandona quindi il fidanzato, un giovane meccanico, per recarsi a Roma, dove spera di trovare un ricco amante.Vera è una ballerina in una compagnia di guitti del varietà che abbandona i suoi sogni per amore. Margherita, invece, è una timida ragazzina che sogna di intraprendere la carriera di attrice...

programme.title: Splendor
programme.desc: Il proprietario, il proiezionista e la maschera di una sala di provincia che sta per chiudere i battenti si abbandonano ai ricordi: ma quando gli operai stanno già schiodando le poltrone...

programme.title: Iwo Jima, deserto di fuoco
programme.desc: Film ambientato durante la seconda guerra mondiale. Il sergente Stryke deve addestrare una squadra di fucilieri della marina. La sua durezza e inflessibilità si riveleranno preziose al momento di sbarcare a Iwo Jima.

programme.title: I'm not here
programme.desc: Steve è perseguitato dal suo passato: ogni oggetto della sua casa o ogni suono che sente gli ricorda un evento specifico della sua esistenza. Collegando ciò che gli è capitato, cerca di scoprire come mai sia finito distrutto e da solo. Mentre rivive ogni significativo ricordo, capisce quali problemi generazionali lo hanno reso prigioniero, come accaduto a suo padre prima di lui. Potrà mai superare il dolore, perdonare chi gli ha fatto del male, e cosa più importante, trovare pace con se stesso?

programme.title: The Way Ahead
programme.desc: Dramma sulla Seconda Guerra Mondiale che segue un gruppo di reclute britanniche, a partire dal loro rigoroso addestramento di base e termina con il loro dispiegamento in Nord Africa.

programme.title: Balzac e la piccola sarta cinese
programme.desc: Cina 1971, nel pieno della rivoluzione culturale, due giovani studenti universitari, Luo e Ma, vengono spediti in un campo di rieducazione maoista in un piccolo villaggio ai confini col Tibet. Tra il lavoro duro e la soffocante ignoranza della comunità, trovano nella musica e nella presenza di una bellissima ragazza locale gli unici svaghi della loro miserabile vita.

programme.title: Rodeo & Juliet
programme.desc: Juliet, ragazza di città, va in campagna con la madre per le vacanze. Mentre la madre ritroverà un vecchio amore, Juliet scoprirà una nuova passione per l'equitazione… grazie anche al cowboy che le insegna a cavalcare

programme.title: IL CLUB DELL'AMORE: IL VIAGGIO DI SYDNEY
programme.desc: Sydney è un'ex atleta che ora fa la food blogger. In tutto questo, nel suo cuore non sembra mai essere passata la cotta per Theo, suo ex cmpagno di college. E rivedersi dopo 10 anni cambierà qualcosa?

programme.title: IL PARTNER PERFETTO
programme.desc: Charley, fondatrice di una app di dating, dopo una rottura publbica col fidanzato si trova vicina alla bancarotta. Solo con lil supproto di Liam, un esperto di marketing sicuro di sé, riuscirà a salvare la sua compagnia (e non solo)

programme.title: Heart Beats
programme.desc: Dagli autori di Step Up e Save The Last Dance, un film emozionante a ritmo di musica e ricco di fantastiche coreografie. Kelli, una ragazza americana con la passione per la danza, parte per un viaggio in India con la famiglia. L'incontro con un giovane ballerino le farà conoscere nuove tecniche e nuovi ritmi di danza, facendola innamorare perdutamente di una terra piena di fascino e mistero.

programme.title: The Iceman
programme.desc: Durante la dinastia Ming, quattro soldati ricevono dall'imperatore il compito di scortare un amuleto. Una serie di tradimenti li catapulterà nel XXI secolo dopo un sonno forzato nei ghiacci durato secoli

programme.title: Le due verità
programme.desc: Diretto da Paul Schrader uno dei registi cardine del cinema americano degli anni '70! Alan, giovane bagnino di Miami, ha una relazione con Ella Brice, in vacanza col marito Mark. Scoperta la tresca, Mark uccide il rivale o almeno così crede...

programme.title: Se Permetti Non Parlarmi Di Bambini
programme.desc: Da quando si è separato, Gabriel non ha fatto altro che pensare a sua figlia Sofia. Un giorno si presenta al suo negozio di musica Vicky, una donna del suo passato, oggi più affascinante che mai, a cui però non piacciono i bambini.

programme.title: True women IT
programme.desc: Nel west dei mitici anni della frontiera Georgia Lawshe Woods si oppone alle strette regole morali per affermare sé stessa. Si appassiona alla politica affronta i pericoli della guerra e combatte l'ostilità degli indiani.

Janet si trasferisce da sola in un nuovo appartamento. La ragazza comincia ad essere vittima di allucinazioni e scopre che tra quelle quattro mura aleggia un'inquietante presenza, che la condurrà al suicidio. Lara, la sorella, decide allora di indagare sulla scomparsa della sorella...

programme.title: Hansel e Gretel e La Strega Della Foresta Nera
programme.desc: I fratelli Hansel e Gretel, abbandonati nel bosco, finiscono nella casa di una strega che intende cucinarli. I due riescono non solo a fuggire ma anche ad uccidere la strega. Quest'episodio trasforma la loro vita, che da quel momento in poi i due decidono di dedicare alla lotta alle streghe.

programme.title: Un Ragionevole Dubbio
programme.desc: Mitch, un brillante procuratore, investe accidentalmente un passante, scappando senza prestargli soccorso. Dopo aver scoperto che un uomo è stato arrestato al suo posto, i sensi di colpa spingeranno Mitch a far cadere le accuse. E se Mitch si fosse sbagliato? Se quell'uomo non fosse innocente?

programme.title: La baia di Eva
programme.desc: Nel caldo sud della Louisiana degli anni ‘60, la giovane Eve Batiste scopre gli oscuri segreti della sua famiglia benestante. Dopo aver assistito a un tradimento del padre, il carismatico dottor Louis Batiste, la sua innocenza si sgretola tra verità scomode e superstizioni. Un dramma avvolto da mistero e magia, dove il confine tra ricordi e realtà si fa sempre più labile.

programme.title: La verità non può aspettare
programme.desc: Nicole Johnson è una stimata professoressa di criminologia che difende la sua studentessa prodigio dalle accuse di aver brutalmente ucciso la sua compagna di stanza.

programme.title: Briciole d'amore
programme.desc: Un uomo chiede a una donna di sposarlo… il giorno stesso in cui si conoscono.

programme.title: Cucinare con amore
programme.desc: La laboriosa produttrice televisiva, Kelly, non ha tempo per l'amore. Kelly si tuffa in un'altra stagione di un programma di cucina per bambini, quando lo chef Stephen dalla testa calda viene catapultato nella vita di Kelly come ospite sostituto dell'ultimo minuto. Mentre i due lottano per realizzare uno spettacolo di successo, si rendono conto di avere molto più in comune di quanto pensassero.

programme.title: Vuoi cucinare con me?
programme.desc: Joel è l'arrogante proprietario di una famosa catena di fast food a base di piatti messicani. Alla ricerca di nuovi piatti da proporre con successo nel menu, parte per il New Mexico, dove la grintosa Javiera Torres è famosa per le sue prelibatezze culinarie.

programme.title: Un matrimonio sotto l'albero
programme.desc: Due genitori single con figlie piccole si avvicinano mentre collaborano ai rispettivi progetti: Cadence con il matrimonio e Henry con la sua cliente di alto profilo, la signora Sutton, e la sua festa VIP annuale della vigilia di Natale.

programme.title: Una pasticceria d'amare
programme.desc: Jessie Dale è una fornaia di terza generazione che ama la sua pasticceria più di ogni altra cosa al mondo. Quando gli sviluppatori minacciano di acquistare il suo edificio e costringerla ad andarsene, deve fare tutto il possibile per salvare la sua panetteria, il tutto mentre si destreggia in una storia d'amore in fiore con il fratello del suo cliente.

programme.title: Il bersaglio perfetto
programme.desc: Fingendo di avere 18 anni, Amara usa un'app per trovare un fidanzato, Shane. A sua madre, Diane, il ragazzo non piace e indaga a fondo nel suo passato.

programme.title: Quello che non ti aspetti
programme.desc: Due rivali in affari, un proprietario di caffetteria e un dirigente di una grande catena, diventano accidentalmente corrispondenti quando agiscono per conto dei loro rispettivi amici e inconsapevolmente si attraggono l'un l'altro.

programme.title: Dance off: sfida a ritmo di danza
programme.desc: Due squadre di danza rivali della stessa città si affrontano per il Campionato Nazionale.

programme.title: Un amore ritrovato
programme.desc: Una giovane vedova torna a casa per la prima volta in tre anni per aiutare a preparare il matrimonio della sorella. È costretta ad affrontare il suo passato, incluso l'uomo per cui non si aspettava di innamorarsi.

programme.title: Maurice
programme.desc: A Cambridge, all'inizio del secolo, Clive e Maurice scoprono di essere attratti l'un l'altro, ma il senso del decoro li allontana.

programme.title: Dopo l'uragano
programme.desc: La vita di un giovanissimo cuoco viene travolta dall'arrivo dell'uragano Sandy nel 2012.

programme.title: La programmazione riprenderà a breve
programme.desc: Ci stiamo concedendo un sonno riparatore per tornare più belli di prima! Resta sintonizzato e presto arriveranno altre proposte straordinarie di intrattenimento a cura di Rakuten TV.

programme.title: Amore a prima… offerta
programme.desc: Liz è soddisfatta della sua vita. L'unica cosa che le manca è il suo Principe Azzurro. È allora che George Barrow, un affascinante magnate immobiliare, bussa alla sua porta. È lui l'uomo perfetto che stava cercando, o la sta solo corteggiando per convincerla a vendere la casa di famiglia?

programme.title: Ritorno a Romance
programme.desc: Zoe Davis è una wedding planner di successo e molto determinata che vive in una grande città. Quando il padre le chiede di aiutarlo nel ristorante di famiglia, lei torna volentieri nella sua accogliente città natale di Romance, nell'Oregon.

programme.title: Batti Cuore
programme.desc: La podcaster Samantha Desouza è incaricata di ospitare uno show per riunire gli amori perduti. Anche se l'amore è l'ultima cosa nella sua mente, Samantha si innamora dell'affascinante Jake. Questa volta Samantha seguirà il suo cuore?

programme.title: Uno chef per Natale
programme.desc: Quando la corrispondente di cibo, Carly, ottiene una possibilità al suo spettacolo, viene mandata ad Angel Heights per aiutare Grant ad aprire la sua tavola calda.

programme.title: La regina del Natale
programme.desc: Ashley è sempre stata la "regina del Natale" in città. Questo finché non incontra il suo partner, Ben, un bel ragazzo nuovo in città, che ama il Natale tanto quanto lei. Uniscono le forze per rendere il Natale ancora più significativo.

programme.title: Un bambino per due
programme.desc: Trovandosi con il bambino di un ammiratore tra le mani, la conduttrice di un programma televisivo mattutino e il suo collega si scoprono innamorati mentre si prendono cura del piccolo insieme.

programme.title: Un bianco Natale
programme.desc: Kelly Mitchum torna a casa per trascorrere il Natale con la sua famiglia. Mentre sogna di trovare il suo uomo perfetto, incontra il l'imprenditore Forrest Newell. Ora, con la casa della sua famiglia a rischio di demolizione, Forrest può aiutarla?

programme.title: Monica e il desiderio
programme.desc: Monica e Harry, giovani e innamorati, fuggono dalla routine di Stoccolma per vivere un'estate di libertà su un'isola. Ma l'idillio si sgretola presto, tra responsabilità e desideri contrastanti, mettendo alla prova il loro amore.

programme.title: Love n' Dancing
programme.desc: Siamo nel 2002: Jake Mitchell è un campione di danza swing che vince insieme a Corinne, sua partner nella vita e nella danza, il campionato mondiale. Jake è un ballerino particolare: è sordo per via di un'infezione all'orecchio da quando era adolescente, ma, nonostante questo, ha imparato a sentire le vibrazioni della musica in un modo tutto suo e ha iniziato a ballare. Oggi Jack è diventato un insegnante di ballo in giro per il mondo. Jessica Donovan è una insegnante di inglese, che ha abbondanato il sogno di ballare a Broadway per un lavoro più sicuro. Ha una relazione con Kent, ma tra i due le cose non vanno. Quando Jack e Jessica si incontrano è subito scintilla, non solo nella vita ma anche sul palco: i due, infatti, provano a competere per il nuovo campionato del mondo. Riusciranno a trionfare come coppia di ballo e non solo?

programme.title: Lei
programme.desc: Los Angeles, in un futuro non troppo lontano. Theodore, un uomo solitario dal cuore spezzato che si guadagna da vivere scrivendo lettere “personali” per gli altri, acquista un sistema informatico di nuova generazione progettato per soddisfare tutte le esigenze dell'utente. Il nome della voce del sistema operativo è Samantha, che si dimostra sensibile, profonda e divertente. Il rapporto di Theodore e Samantha crescerà e l'amicizia si trasformerà in amore ma…

programme.title: Le stelle non si spengono a Liverpool
programme.desc: Liverpool, 1979. Quella che inizia come una vivace relazione tra una leggendaria femme fatale e il suo giovane amante si trasforma rapidamente in un rapporto più profondo, con Turner che è l'unica persona a cui Gloria si permette di rivolgersi per trovare conforto e forza.

programme.title: Cacciatore di teste
programme.desc: Bruno Davert è un manager del settore della carta di mezza età che ha perso il lavoro a causa di una ristrutturazione e delocalizzazione della sua azienda. Convinto di trovare immediatamente un altro lavoro all'altezza del suo curriculum, dopo oltre due anni di ricerche si ritrova ancora disoccupato. Decide così di mettere in atto un piano destinato a restituirgli il lavoro presso la principale azienda del settore, la Arcadia. Il piano consiste nell'eliminazione fisica di tutti i suoi principali concorrenti, altri manager che come lui hanno perso il posto e vivono di espedienti partecipando ad umilianti colloqui di lavoro.

programme.title: Anatar
programme.desc: Il popolo degli Anatar, alieni umanoidi che si sono evoluti dalle anatre e sono alla ricerca di un nuovo corpo celeste da chiamare nido. Nel loro peregrinaggio spaziale approdano su Pandoro: un luogo dove essere viventi e natura hanno trovato il loro strano equilibrio. Amore, guerra astronavi e papere spaziali sono gli ingredienti di questa grottesca fiaba moderna sull' accettazione di cio che è diverso da noi.

programme.title: Misstake
programme.desc: In una villa rurale alle porte di Vicenza si riuniscono un gruppo strampalato di tipi umani. Tutti sono lì per lo stesso motivo: ambiscono al possesso della casa. Quando uno degli ospiti muore improvvisamente, le divergenze tra loro si inaspriscono.

programme.title: Mister Universo
programme.desc: Tairo, giovane domatore di leoni, è infelice. La scomparsa del suo portafortuna è la scusa per intraprendere un viaggio attraverso l'Italia in cerca di Arthur Robin, ex mister Universo, che gliel'aveva regalato.

programme.title: Unico nell'isola della Magia
programme.desc: In questo film Unico conosce Cherry e suo fratello che lavora per il malvagio mago Kuruku. Questo malvagio mago ha l'ossessione di trasformare tutti in marionette. L'obiettivo del piccolo unicorno sarà quello di sconfiggere il folle Kuruku e riportare la pace nel mondo. Il secondo film inedito intitolato: Unico nell'isola della magia, arriva per la prima volta doppiato in lingua italiana.

programme.title: Non dirmelo non ci credo
programme.desc: George è un bugiardo patologico il cui passaggio da un ospedale psichiatrico al mondo esterno viene assistito da Eddie, un truffatore uscito di galera per fare assistenza sociale. Quando un passante scambia George per un miliardario scomparso, Eddie lo convince a impersonarlo: George prende quindi il posto dell'uomo ingannando chiunque, anche la sexy Elaine, moglie del miliardario scomparso.

programme.title: Pioggia di soldi
programme.desc: Johnny Stewart è un imbroglione che decide di rigare dritto dopo aver scampato la prigione grazie al socio del suo defunto padre. Nonostante la sua riluttanza a trovare un vero lavoro, fa domanda presso una grande società di carte di credito. Ottenuto il lavoro, si rende conto di guadagnare poco e riprendere quello che sa fare meglio meglio: la truffa. Però, si troverà presto coinvolto nelle indagini di un elaborato racket di carte di credito, proprio presso la sua azienda.

programme.title: Tutte Le Cose Che Non Sai Di Lui
programme.desc: Jennifer Garner è la star di Catch and Release della scrittrice-regista Susannah Grant. Dopo la morte improvvisa del fidanzato, Gray Wheeler (Garner) trova conforto nei suoi amici: lo spensierato Sam (Kevin Smith), il super responsabile Dennis (Sam Jaeger) e, abbastanza stranamente, il suo vecchio amico d'infanzia Fritz (Timothy Olyphant), un irresponsabile playboy.

programme.title: Tutte le ex del mio ragazzo
programme.desc: Brittany Murphy catturerà il vostro cuore in questo divertentissimo film su una brava ragazza che non ne combina una giusta. Assunta per lavorare in un talk show televisivo, la vita di Stacy Holt è stravolta quando viene convinta ad esplorare uno dei temi del programma e controlla l'agenda del suo ragazzo. Ma si è dimenticata una cosa: nel mondo della TV, c'è sempre una sorpresa scioccante dietro l'angolo -- e lei ne avrà una bella grande!

programme.title: Mi faccia causa
programme.desc: Davanti al pretore Giovanni Pennisi transita tutti i giorni un campionario di varia umanità,

programme.title: Quando le donne si chiamavano Madonne
programme.desc: Tre giovani vanno a Prato, tra amori, un processo per adulterio e conquiste di belle ragazze del posto.

programme.title: Scusi ma lei le paga le tasse
programme.desc: Un funzionario cade in disgrazia per colpa del nipote, che poi gli soffia la promozione.

programme.title: Il segreto del giaguaro
programme.desc: Romano de Roma , maniaco degli anni '70, er Piotta alias "il Giaguaro" gestisce un bar a piazza Vittorio.

programme.title: Io tigro tu tigri egli tigra
programme.desc: Film a episodi con Renato Pozzetto, Cochi Ponzoni, Paolo Villaggio ed Enrico Montesano

programme.title: Arrivano i bersaglieri
programme.desc: 20 settembre 1870: i bersaglieri entrano a Roma tra uccisioni, amori e vendette sullo sfondo papale

programme.title: Pane, burro e marmellata
programme.desc: Bruno, lasciato dalla moglie, trova rifugio da tre donne e diventa il sultano del loro piccolo harem

programme.title: Il casinista
programme.desc: Il comico Marullo spinge l'amico Casciotta a scrivere storie reali, scatenando una serie di disavventure.

programme.title: Anni difficili
programme.desc: Con Umberto Spadaro, Massimo Girotti e Ave Ninchi, Aldo Piscitello deve aderire al Partito Fascista e affrontare la guerra. Tra doveri familiari e scelte morali, cerca il coraggio di restare fedele a sé stesso in un'Italia in crisi.

programme.title: Brutti Sporchi e cattivi
programme.desc: Commedia nera e grottesca in una baraccopoli romana: Nino Manfredi è Giacinto, patriarca pugliese che difende il suo denaro tra furti e scherzi familiari. Capolavoro di Ettore Scola, vincitore del premio miglior regia a Cannes.

programme.title: Il fischio al naso
programme.desc: Un uomo, interpretato da Ugo Tognazzi, si ritrova coinvolto in una serie di situazioni comiche e paradossali, tutto a causa di un fischio al naso che cambia inaspettatamente la sua vita. Una commedia surreale e ironica che esplora la follia delle circostanze.

programme.title: I tartassati
programme.desc: Totò e Aldo Fabrizi, alle prese con le difficoltà quotidiane, affrontano la burocrazia e le complicazioni fiscali con una serie di disavventure comiche e situazioni paradossali, esplorando con ironia le difficoltà della vita moderna.

programme.title: Cose Nostre
programme.desc: Fred Blake, alias Giovanni Manzoni, ovvero il pentito più famoso degli Stati Uniti messo sotto protezione dall'FBI, è costretto a trasferirsi con moglie i figli in Normandia per non farsi rintracciare dalla mafia americana. Adattarsi alla nuova vita, però, non è risulta essere così facile...

programme.title: American Carnage
programme.desc: Una nuova legge permette l' arresto dei figli di immigrati irregolari. Per evitare il carcere i giovani hanno una sola opportunità: fare volontariato in una misteriosa casa di cura fornendo assistenza agli anziani.

programme.title: X+Y
programme.desc: Nathan è un giovane ragazzo affetto da una forma di autismo. Il professor Humphreys lo sprona a partecipare alle Olimpiadi della Matematica.

programme.title: Intrighi di potere
programme.desc: Washington D.C., città piena di leader politici, logora un ex membro del Congresso che, caduto in rovina, cerca di rientrare nel giro politico.

programme.title: Girl in Progress
programme.desc: Grace è una madre single. È troppo impegnata a destreggiarsi tra il lavoro, le bollette e lo sposatissimo Dr. Hartford per dare a sua figlia Ansiedad l'attenzione di cui ha disperatamente bisogno.

programme.title: Io, Dio E Bin Laden
programme.desc: Gary Faulkner, ex detenuto disoccupato, parte per il Pakistan armato solo di una spada acquistata in TV. Convinto che Dio gliel'abbia chiesto, tenta di catturare Osama Bin Laden compiendo undici viaggi in una folle missione solitaria.

programme.title: Restiamo Amici
programme.desc: Alessandro viene improvvisamente contattato, dal Brasile, dal suo vecchio amico Gigi. In punto di morte, l'uomo ha un ultimo favore: per ereditare i tre milioni di euro che gli ha lasciato suo padre deve intestarli a suo figlio. Ma Gigi non ha eredi.

programme.title: Niente Di Grave, Suo Marito E Incinto
programme.desc: Marco vive a Parigi con Irene. Lei è parrucchiera, lui gestisce una scuola guida. Tutto è tranquillo finché lui non avverte strani disturbi. La diagnosi è incredibile: l'uomo è al quarto mese di gravidanza! La notizia non può che fare il giro del mondo.

programme.title: Love shooting
programme.desc: Charlie è un produttore cinematografico che si lascia convincere a realizzare un film su Benjamin Disraeli, a patto che il protagonista sia un attore di grande fama che però verrà rapito, costringendo Charlie ad escogitare una soluzione creativa.

programme.title: Il Magnifico Avventuriero
programme.desc: Tra intrighi di corte e imprese eroiche, un audace avventuriero affronta duelli e complotti in un viaggio ricco di azione e colpi di scena.

programme.title: Robin, frecce, fagioli e karate
programme.desc: Un improbabile eroe si ritrova coinvolto in combattimenti e situazioni esilaranti tra azione e comicità. Diretto da Tonino Ricci.

programme.title: Ettore Fieramosca
programme.desc: Nell'Italia rinascimentale, il valoroso Ettore Fieramosca guida i cavalieri italiani nella celebre sfida contro i francesi, tra onore, rivalità e spirito patriottico.

programme.title: Sandokan alla Riscossa
programme.desc: Tra mari esotici e scontri contro il potere coloniale, Sandokan torna a combattere per la libertà del suo popolo, tra arrembaggi e duelli.

programme.title: Ercole contro i tiranni di Babilonia
programme.desc: Tra complotti e battaglie spettacolari, Ercole sfida i tiranni di Babilonia per salvare il regno e ristabilire la giustizia.

programme.title: I due volti della vendetta
programme.desc: Dopo aver rapinato una banca messicana, papà Longworth prende il bottino e lascia il suo compagno Rio per essere catturato ma Rio fugge e cerca papà in California.

programme.title: L'agente speciale Pinkerton
programme.desc: Un agente speciale di Chicago viene mandato a ovest per catturare i famigerati fratelli Reno.

programme.title: Per il gusto di uccidere
programme.desc: Hank Fellows è un cacciatore di taglie che si dedica anche al recupero del bottino che le bande di rapinatori rubano dalle banche.

programme.title: Ed ora... raccomanda l'anima a Dio!
programme.desc: Due uomini stanno andando a Denver City per regolare un conto personale. Uno cerca l'assassino di suo padre, l'altro un ex amico che gli ha rubato l'oro. A loro si unisce una terza persona, un misterioso pistolero.

programme.title: Viva Gringo
programme.desc: Degli emissari peruviani negoziano la pace con gli Incas, ma un bandito li incolpa per il delitto del sovrano.

programme.title: Viva Gringo
programme.desc: Degli emissari peruviani negoziano la pace con gli Incas, ma un bandito li incolpa per il delitto del sovrano.

programme.title: I tre implacabili
programme.desc: Cèsar cerca vendetta per la morte della moglie, assassinata da banditi nel tentativo di derubare il suo ranch.

programme.title: I tre implacabili
programme.desc: Cèsar cerca vendetta per la morte della moglie, assassinata da banditi nel tentativo di derubare il suo ranch.

programme.title: Non toccare la donna bianca
programme.desc: La battaglia di Custer e la disfatta di Little Big Horn sono ambientate nella fossa delle Halles a Parigi.

programme.title: Non toccare la donna bianca
programme.desc: La battaglia di Custer e la disfatta di Little Big Horn sono ambientate nella fossa delle Halles a Parigi.

programme.title: La notte rossa del falco
programme.desc: Un pistolero errante arriva in una città del vecchio West, dove affronta crimine e illegalità.

programme.title: La notte rossa del falco
programme.desc: Un pistolero errante arriva in una città del vecchio West, dove affronta crimine e illegalità.

programme.title: La resa dei conti
programme.desc: Il cacciatore di taglie Jonathan Corbett è stato assunto per catturare un giovane messicano accusato di stupro.

programme.title: La resa dei conti

Nel 2067 la Terra è stata devastata dai cambiamenti climatici e l'umanità è costretta a vivere respirando ossigeno artificiale. Una malattia causata dal suddetto ossigeno sta uccidendo la popolazione e l'unica speranza di una cura arriva in forma di un messaggio dal futuro.

programme.title: The Reincarnation Of Isabel
programme.desc: Deep in the cellar of a cursed Italian castle, Satanists are cutting out the hearts and drinking the blood of virgins as sacrifice to their diabolic mistress Isabella! A vampire and witch, Isabella was staked through the heart and burned to death in the 14th century. But at the coming of the 25th moon, Isabella will reincarnate in another body... the body of a beautiful virgin!

programme.title: Benny Loves You
